speaker: A
name: Alex
text: Did you enjoy traveling by car when you were a kid?

speaker: B
name: Mia
text: Actually, no, I didn't. My father is a worker — the kind of guy who builds and renovates houses — and his car was always full of tools. Dirty, smelly tools everywhere. So whenever I rode in his car, I had to put up with that smell for the whole ride, and it made me dizzy. So no, I didn't enjoy traveling by car as a kid.
